scenicChapters.title: Mount Baker Highway
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 50 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go — slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.

scenicChapters.title: Mount Baker Highway
scenicChapters.narrative: For 5 km this is Mount Baker Highway, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it. Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.

mount-baker-highway.story: A 162 km one-way ride from near Bellingham, about 2 h 43 of riding. On the way it passes Glacier Washington and Heather Meadows. The highest point is about 1,300 m. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.
